description: This file defines the SerializationEntryCodec class, which implements the IFieldCodec interface for serializing and deserializing SerializationEntrySurrogate objects within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It contains methods for writing and reading serialization entries, handling various field types and wire protocol details.

classes.name: SerializationEntryCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for SerializationEntrySurrogate, providing methods to serialize and deserialize serialization entries.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a SerializationEntrySurrogate object into the writer, writing its Name, Value, and ObjectType fields with appropriate headers.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader to reconstruct a SerializationEntrySurrogate object, reading fields based on headers and handling unknown fields.
